title: Scientists discover how harmful “zombie cells” hide from the immune system
caption:
Your body has a way of clearing out damaged, aging cells—but some manage to stick around. Scientists have discovered a protein called PD-L2 that might act as a mask, helping these 'zombie cells' evade the immune system and fuel inflammation. New research in mice shows that blocking this protein could be a path toward healthier aging.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover how harmful “zombie cells” hide from the immune system
